description: Evaluate proposed terms against an exact offer and the seller's published rules in a forced dry run. Returns rules-evaluation JSON text or validation errors. Inspect the offer first and supply its required terms. Never submits a proposal, contacts a seller, or writes a negotiation.

budget.description: Buyer-proposed budget or range as text, using the offer currency, for example USD 500. Do not invent a budget.

offer.description: Exact offer key from the listing manifest, for example services-0 or products-1.

query.description: Buyer request describing the desired work or product and relevant context.

requestedTerms.description: Structured buyer proposal. Published seller rules may require scope (text or list of deliverables), revisionCount (whole number 0-1000), and projectWeeks (whole number 1-1000). Example: {"scope":"Logo and brand guide","revisionCount":2,"projectWeeks":4}. Inspect the offer rules; omit unknown terms rather than inventing them.

slug.description: Exact published listing slug returned by discovery, not a full URL.

timeline.description: Buyer-proposed delivery timing as text, for example within 4 weeks. Use requestedTerms.projectWeeks for a numeric duration rule.

name: nexez_validate_negotiation
title: Validate Nexez negotiation
